protocol.label: b2-ingest2
protocol.study: VOCR6.2 S/N/L baseline on hooked pools v2.1 (report only: no selection, no decision; input to the recommendation)

arms.read: eval/pagepath.py run --heads (each blob's head sections, Rubi's re-read), W8I C runtime, LM vocr_lm6_o3_1000k.vlm 41591acc alpha 600 beta 2500 flags 1 (BOS), counter re-decode 6000/4000, cascade conf 700 (S->N, N->L), Rubi 0.10.5 (3d415cd) textnorm, filter lines

finders.spot: textspot8_t64n8c16_w8.vtsp e129d41a crop decode on the region (Rubi's default finder)
finders.oracle: each reference line's box + pad (clean crops)

hval.note: every hval page's regions (base/+4/+8), pagepool v2.1; groups: titles new in v2 vs titles of pools v1 (VOCR6.2's training titles)

new_all.note: every page of the train titles new in v2 (train+guard+hval; VOCR6.2 never trained on them), base regions

protocol.metric: dialogue CER (pagepath score_unit), pooled per group x platform x tier x finder, 95% interval: title-cluster bootstrap (10,000, seed 0); per title
protocol.not_read: the test titles (PCSG00807, NPJH50882), vita-test, psp-test, CLANNAD, the dev sets
protocol.note: a first read on pools v2's units (superseded by v2.1 for label errors in 9 titles) ran 00:30-01:20Z; its crop readings are cached and reused; the v2 numbers are not reported

groups_rule: new: titles pools v1 did not hold (VOCR6.2 never trained on them); v1: pools v1's titles
ci: 95% bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 0, over titles (pages when a group has < 5)
